en: The image is a vintage-style postcard depicting a large round building with a minaret, typical of Ottoman architecture. The building is surrounded by tiled rooftops of smaller houses, under a blue and yellow sky. At the top left, the card says 'Souvenir de Salonique,' and at the bottom, 'L'Eglise de St. Georges (Rotonde).' The overall colors and printing style suggest an early 20th century origin.
